title: IT60114: Internetworking And Applications
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisite: NoneIntroduction to the Internet and Protocols; Switching and
Routing : Layer-2/Layer-3 switching, RIP, OSPF, ISIS, BGP; Multilayer LAN;
Multicast and broadcast; Multimedia networks: Streaming stored audio and video,
Webcast; Broadband access network; Applied Internetworking : Voice-over-IP
(VoIP), Quality-of-Service (QoS), Convergence of Voice, Video and data; Access
Network fundamentals : RAS, Access Routers, DSL, MAN, VPN; Network Security :
ACL, Firewall.
